title: Lossy Output Gate Mappings Leaking Sensitive Fields
pattern: Generating public API output models directly from internal schemas using default field derivation rules without explicit field filtering.
why_bad: It causes critical security and privacy leaks. Sensitive details (e.g. hashed credentials, internal flags) get exposed on public networks because the boundary map is generic.
detection: Match structs derived for public APIs that replicate identical fields of internal database row schemas including known sensitive terms.
counterexample: Internal admin-only payloads with explicit authorization checks. Mark as `Context-dependent`.
source: *Domain Modeling made Functional* by Scott Wlaschin (Chapter 11, p. 133, "Output Gates and Information Leakage").
